info.title: Emoji Voting API Service
info.description: Provides voting API for emoji, allowing voting for specific emojis and querying poll results. Exposes gRPC endpoints for internal consumption. | 101 routes discovered

tags.name: voting
tags.description: Operations for casting votes and retrieving voting/poll results
